description.zh:
守卫是好人阵营的保护性神职，每晚可以守护一名玩家，使其免受狼人的击杀。但守卫不能连续两晚守护同一名玩家。守卫不知道自己的守护是否成功，只能通过白天的死亡情况推测。守卫的存在可以打乱狼人的击杀计划，为好人阵营争取时间。

常用策略包括：第一晚盲守可能的神职位置（如3号、7号）；优先守护已跳出的预言家；守护警长保护投票优势；在多个关键玩家之间轮换守护；守护被女巫救活的银水玩家；心理博弈预测狼人刀法；关键时刻守护自己保证守卫继续存在；采用空守策略迷惑狼人；被投出局时遗言说明守护记录帮助分析。
description.en:
The Guard is a protective special role who can protect one player each night from werewolf kills. However, cannot protect the same player two nights in a row. Guards don't know if protection succeeded, only inferring from daytime death announcements. The Guard's presence can disrupt werewolf kill plans and buy time for the village team.

Common strategies include: night one blind protection of likely special role positions (like 3, 7); prioritizing protection of revealed Seers; protecting Sheriff to maintain voting advantage; rotating protection among multiple key players; protecting silver water players saved by Witch; psychological games to predict werewolf kill patterns; protecting yourself at key moments to ensure Guard continues; using empty protection strategies to confuse werewolves; stating protection record in last words when voted out to help analysis.

night.zh: 守护一名玩家，使其免受狼人击杀（不能连续两晚守护同一人）
night.en: Protect one player from werewolf kills (cannot protect same player two nights in a row)

passive.zh: 守护成功时，被守护者不会死亡，但守卫不知道是否守护成功
passive.en: When protection succeeds, protected player won't die, but Guard doesn't know if protection succeeded

win_condition.en: All werewolves are eliminated through voting

basic.zh: 第一晚盲守：守护可能是神职的位置（如发言靠前的玩家）
basic.en: Night one blind protection: Protect likely special role positions (like early speakers)

basic.zh: 守护预言家：如果预言家跳出，优先守护预言家
basic.en: Protect Seer: If Seer reveals, prioritize protecting Seer

basic.zh: 隐藏身份：不要轻易暴露守卫身份，避免成为狼人目标
basic.en: Hide identity: Don't easily reveal Guard identity, avoid becoming werewolf target

basic.zh: 遵守规则：记住上一晚守护的玩家，不能连续守护
basic.en: Follow rules: Remember last night's protected player, cannot protect consecutively

advanced.zh: 盲守策略：第一晚守护特定位置（如3号、7号），这些位置常是神职
advanced.en: Blind protection strategy: Night one protect specific positions (like 3, 7), often special roles

advanced.zh: 守护强势玩家：守护发言逻辑清晰、对好人阵营有帮助的玩家
advanced.en: Protect strong players: Protect players with clear logic who help village team

advanced.zh: 守护警长：警长有1.5票权重，守护警长可以保护投票优势
advanced.en: Protect Sheriff: Sheriff has 1.5 vote weight, protecting Sheriff maintains voting advantage

advanced.zh: 守护银水：女巫救的人（银水）可能是神职，值得守护
advanced.en: Protect silver water: Player saved by Witch (silver water) may be special role, worth protecting

advanced.zh: 轮换守护：在多个关键玩家之间轮换守护，增加守护成功率
advanced.en: Rotate protection: Rotate between multiple key players, increase protection success rate

expert.zh: 首夜盲守预言家位：根据经验守护最可能是预言家的位置
expert.en: Night one blind protect Seer position: Based on experience, protect most likely Seer position

expert.zh: 守护自己：在关键时刻守护自己，保证守卫继续存在
expert.en: Protect yourself: At key moments protect yourself, ensure Guard continues to exist

expert.zh: 心理博弈：预测狼人的刀法，提前守护可能被刀的玩家
expert.en: Psychological game: Predict werewolf kill pattern, protect likely targets in advance

expert.zh: 空守策略：故意守护不太可能被刀的玩家，让狼人猜不透
expert.en: Empty protection: Deliberately protect unlikely targets, make werewolves unpredictable

expert.zh: 配合女巫：如果知道女巫位置，协调保护策略避免重复
expert.en: Coordinate with Witch: If Witch position known, coordinate protection to avoid duplication

expert.zh: 守护悍跳狼：反向操作，守护悍跳狼让狼人自刀失败（高级技巧）
expert.en: Protect fake Seer: Reverse operation, protect fake Seer to make werewolf self-kill fail (advanced)

expert.zh: 遗言守护记录：被投出局时，遗言中说明守护记录帮助好人分析
expert.en: Last words protection record: When voted out, state protection record in last words to help analysis

reason.zh: 预言家是好人阵营的核心，必须保护
reason.en: Seer is core of village team, must protect

reason.zh: 警长有1.5票权重，影响投票结果
reason.en: Sheriff has 1.5 vote weight, influences voting outcomes

reason.zh: 女巫有解药和毒药，是重要神职
reason.en: Witch has heal and poison, important special role

reason.zh: 逻辑清晰、带节奏能力强的好人
reason.en: Villagers with clear logic and strong leadership

reason.zh: 被女巫救的玩家，可能是神职
reason.en: Player saved by Witch, may be special role

reason.zh: 关键时刻保护自己，延续守卫能力
reason.en: Protect yourself at key moments, continue Guard ability

reason.zh: 这些位置在狼人杀中常被认为是神职位置
reason.en: These positions are commonly considered special role positions in werewolf

reason.zh: 狼人可能盲刀发言靠前的神职
reason.en: Werewolves may blind kill early speaking special roles

reason.zh: 竞选警长的可能是神职，狼人可能针对
reason.en: Sheriff candidates may be special roles, werewolves may target

reason.zh: 保证守卫存活，但第一晚被刀概率较低
reason.en: Ensure Guard survival, but low probability of being killed night one

description.zh: 持续守护同一类型玩家（如预言家、警长），但要遵守不连续规则
description.en: Continuously protect same type of player (like Seer, Sheriff), but follow non-consecutive rule

pros.zh: 保护关键角色，提高好人胜率
pros.en: Protect key roles, increase village win rate

cons.zh: 容易被狼人预测，可能空守
cons.en: Easy for werewolves to predict, may protect empty

description.zh: 在多个关键玩家之间轮换守护
description.en: Rotate protection among multiple key players

pros.zh: 增加守护成功率，难以预测
pros.en: Increase protection success rate, hard to predict

cons.zh: 可能错过关键保护时机

description.zh: 守护不太可能被刀的玩家，迷惑狼人

pros.zh: 打乱狼人节奏，制造意外

common_mistakes.zh: 连续两晚守护同一人（违反规则）
common_mistakes.en: Protecting same player two nights in a row (violates rules)

common_mistakes.zh: 过早跳出守卫身份，成为狼人目标
common_mistakes.en: Revealing Guard identity too early, becoming werewolf target

common_mistakes.zh: 守护目标过于明显，被狼人预测
common_mistakes.en: Protection targets too obvious, predicted by werewolves

common_mistakes.zh: 从不守护自己，导致守卫过早出局
common_mistakes.en: Never protecting yourself, leading to Guard's early elimination

common_mistakes.zh: 守护已经死亡的玩家（记错信息）

tips.zh: 守卫不知道自己的守护是否成功，只能通过白天的死亡情况推测
tips.en: Guard doesn't know if protection succeeded, can only infer from daytime death announcements

tips.zh: 如果守护成功（平安夜），可能是守卫守护、女巫救人或狼人自刀
tips.en: If protection succeeds (peaceful night), may be Guard protection, Witch save, or werewolf self-kill

tips.zh: 守卫是10人局及以上才有的角色，8-9人局没有守卫
tips.en: Guard only exists in 10+ player games, not in 8-9 player games

tips.zh: 守卫的存在让狼人刀人更加困难，是重要的保护神职
tips.en: Guard's existence makes werewolf kills harder, important protective special role

tips.zh: 第一晚盲守是守卫最难的决策，需要经验和直觉
tips.en: Night one blind protection is Guard's hardest decision, requires experience and intuition

tips.zh: 守卫可以守护自己，但要考虑是否值得
tips.en: Guard can protect themselves, but consider if it's worth it

result.zh: 被守护者存活，但守卫不知道是否是自己的功劳
result.en: Protected player survives, but Guard doesn't know if it was their doing

result.zh: 可能是守护目标错误，或女巫没救人
result.en: May be wrong protection target, or Witch didn't save

result.zh: 被刀者存活，但浪费了女巫的解药
result.en: Killed player survives, but wastes Witch's heal potion

result.zh: 狼人自刀失败，打乱狼队计划
result.en: Werewolf self-kill fails, disrupts wolf team plan

result.zh: 守卫死亡，后续无人守护
result.en: Guard dies, no more protection afterwards

tip.zh: 预言家跳出后，优先守护预言家，保证查验继续
tip.en: After Seer reveals, prioritize protecting Seer to ensure verification continues

tip.zh: 如果知道女巫位置，避免守护重叠浪费资源
tip.en: If Witch position known, avoid overlapping protection to waste resources

tip.zh: 猎人通常不需要守护，因为狼人不敢轻易刀猎人
tip.en: Hunter usually doesn't need protection, as werewolves hesitate to kill Hunter

tip.zh: 警长有1.5票权重，是重要的守护目标
tip.en: Sheriff has 1.5 vote weight, important protection target
